(i) A letter from the Town Clerk of Woollahra Council was read indicat-
ing that they would not support the "Vaucluse House Protection
Campaign" in their objection to a proposed wine licence for the
restaurant, but would act independently when the application came
before the Licencing Court. (Subsequently, at a further meeting
of Council the motion to oppose the licence was rescinded meaning
that the Council would remain neutral.) All Trustees present
expressed satisfaction at Council's decision.
The prime mover in bringing about the recision motion was Alderman
Johnson. It was felt that the Trust could not thank the Alderman
in writing and therefore Mr. Doyle was empowered to thank him
verbally on behalf of the Trust.
It was confirmed that the Catering Company, when applying for a
liquor licence, should ask for the operating hours to be from 12.00
noon to 3.00 p.m. However in the light of new legislation in
State Parliament it was likely that the court would grant longer
hours if they agreed to the application for a licence, but this
would still leave the Trust with the power to restrict trading
hours by agreement with the Catering Company.

was read regarding the security of the two-seater Victorian Toilet

the following day the President kindly offered to frame a suitable
reply.

into safe storage pending the allocation of a more secure display
position.

the first two became fully chargeable to the Special Purposes Account
and in view of the current very substantial nature of this account
(approximately $24,000 p.a.)it is anticipated that much general mainten-
ance of buildings and park facilities will remain chargeable to this
account, especially in view of the fact that major restoration and
development work comes under the five year plan and will be the sub-
ject of special grants (Schedule Item 29). Nevertheless we would have
nothing to lose by asking for funds to cover these two items and it
was decided to ask for $9,000.00 for Building Maintenance (Schedule Item
10) (1973-74 allocation was $5,000.00) and $7,000.00 for park maintenance
(Schedule Item 28) (1973-74 allocation was also $7,000.00, but this in-
cluded Nielsen Park).

(Schedule Item 28) (1973-74 allocation was also $7,000.00, but this in-
cluded Nielsen Park).
